quest:100.text: Call of Water. At Silverpine's coast, the shaman completes the Call of Water at the Brazier of Everfount. The rite clears nearby corruption, and a spirit of pure water appears. At the Brazier of Everfount, your final words call forth a burst of light. It scatters the minor spirits that threaten the spring, and the shore falls quiet. A Minor Manifestation of Water appears beside the brazier after the spirits are gone. The spirit thanks you for the rite and says the taint here has ebbed. Yet life across Silverpine's decaying lands continues to wane, and the Horde's shamans must stay watchful to preserve it.

quest:1007.text: The Ancient Statuette. Near Zoram Strand, The Ancient Statuette lies lost after a naga attack. Talen, an elf camped on the northwestern coast of Ashenvale, needs you to recover the relic he dropped in the surf. Naga attacked Talen as he steered a small vessel through the shallows by Zoram's sunken ruins on Ashenvale's northwestern shore. He scrambled ashore with only bare provisions and made a hasty camp. In his desperate flight, he dropped the ancient statuette he had found among the ruins into the sands. Talen braved the naga-infested Zoram Strand for the ancient statuette. Once you return it, he explains that the drowned city holds centuries of forgotten mysteries. He believes the delicate carving is a key to understanding what remains hidden beneath the tides.

quest:1009.text: Ruuzel. Talen needs the Ring of Zoram to open an ancient statuette found on the strand. The naga have taken the ring to their island sanctuary. Talen believes the Ring of Zoram can open the ancient statuette recovered from the coast. Before the Great Sundering broke Kalimdor and sank its coastal cities, powerful night elven nobles ruled Zoram. The ring belonged among their regalia. After the cataclysm, it vanished beneath the waves for millennia, keeping the secrets of sunken relics from curious eyes. Naga have recently come to the Zoram Strand and begun searching the ruins of their former homeland. Ruuzel, who leads the local brood, found the Ring of Zoram and took it to her sanctuary on an island to the north. Talen, a night elf, asks Alliance travelers to hunt Ruuzel and reclaim the heirloom so he can open the statuette recovered from the shallows.

quest:101.text: The Totem of Infliction. In Darkshire, Madame Eva offers travelers a ward against Duskwood's dangers. She needs ghoul fangs, skeleton fingers, and spider venom to enchant the Totem of Infliction, a charm that strikes back at attackers. Madame Eva reads the fortunes of those who enter her candle-lit home in Darkshire. She senses danger and violence ahead, then offers practical sorcery alongside her divinations. To make a ward against Duskwood's predators, she needs ten ghoul fangs, ten skeleton fingers, and five vials of spider venom gathered from the haunted woods. Madame Eva binds ghoul fangs, fingers from restless skeletons, and spider venom with enchantments. In mortal peril, the totem gives off a magical aura that reflects cruelty, harming anyone who strikes its bearer.

quest:1010.text: Bathran's Hair. At Maestra's Post in western Ashenvale, Orendil Broadleaf seeks Bathran's Hair for a sick child in Astranaar. He believes the illness afflicts the child's spirit, and sends you north to the ancient ruins where the uncommon restorative herb was gathered in the past. Orendil Broadleaf, a night elf herbalist at Maestra's Post, faces a troubling illness. The post lies just south of the Darkshore border. A young child in Astranaar is grievously ill, and ordinary remedies have failed. Orendil believes the sickness afflicts the child's spirit as well as the flesh. He seeks Bathran's Hair, an uncommon restorative herb gathered in the ancient elven ruins to the north.

quest:1011.text: Forsaken Diseases. In eastern Ashenvale, Kayneth Stillwind watches the Forsaken draw nearer. He fears they are brewing blights to ravage sacred elven lands, and sends Alliance champions toward a camp near Dor'Danil Barrow Den to seize a sample. Ashenvale's night elves have long faced satyrs, raging elementals, and orcish logging crews. The Forsaken bring a darker threat. The undead arm of the Horde is taking root near ancient ruins and sacred barrow dens. Their presence brings war and the fear of alchemical plague spreading through Kaldorei groves. South of Forest Song, near Dor'Danil Barrow Den, Forsaken apothecaries and scouts have fortified a camp. They bottle untested toxins among brewing caldrons and foul reagents. Kayneth Stillwind sends scouts inside to recover an intact Bottle of Disease, so its volatile contents can be studied before the Forsaken unleash it across the forest.

quest:1012.text: Insane Druids. A massacre in Dor'Danil Barrow Den leaves its druids' spirits in torment. Kayneth Stillwind, a night elf sentinel in eastern Ashenvale, learns of the slaughter through a vision while battling Forsaken toxins. Kayneth Stillwind sees a massacre in a waking vision. The night elf sentinel is battling the effects of Forsaken toxins found in eastern Ashenvale when he witnesses what happened beneath the mounds of Dor'Danil Barrow Den. Undead infiltrators poisoned the druids in their sleep and slaughtered them. Their souls were torn from their bodies by the venom, leaving them as wild, shrieking spirits. Kayneth Stillwind asks you to quiet the suffering beneath Dor'Danil Barrow Den. The druids' phantoms have been driven mad by the way they died, and cannot find release in the underground chambers. Their circle's three leaders, Taneel Darkwood, Uthil Mooncall, and Mavoris Cloudsbreak, remain among the restless dead. Lay them to rest, and the den may begin to heal from its defilement.

quest:1013.text: The Book of Ur. Keeper Bel'dugur sends Horde champions into Shadowfang Keep for The Book of Ur. In the Undercity's Apothecarium, he seeks the treatise of Ur, a dead mage of Dalaran, for the Forsaken's use of its research into other planes. Before the Third War destroyed Dalaran, the brilliant human wizard Ur devoted his scholarship to realms beyond Azeroth. The Kirin Tor strictly governed conjuration and contact with outer planes, but Ur studied beings from other dimensions, including the savage worgen. He hesitated to wield their alien powers, judging them dangerously uncontrollable. That restraint made his written legacy a coveted prize for those with fewer scruples. Archmage Arugal took Ur's treatise and used its research before settling in Shadowfang Keep. Without Ur's reservations, Arugal summoned bloodthirsty worgen into Silverpine. Their curse consumed Pyrewood and the surrounding valleys. The volume now lies neglected in the keep's towers, watched by Arugal's feral pets.

quest:1014.text: Arugal Must Die. At the Sepulcher, Dalar Dawnweaver sends champions against Arugal. The rogue archmage holds Shadowfang Keep, and his worgen menace threatens the Forsaken’s hold on Silverpine Forest. Shadowfang Keep rises above the woods, where Archmage Arugal commands the worgen. The Forsaken have made the Sepulcher their base, but Silverpine Forest remains dangerous and fiercely contested. Driven mad by guilt and dark sorcery, Arugal unleashed the feral worgen upon Lordaeron. His ravenous beasts roam the forest paths and hinder Lady Sylvanas Windrunner’s efforts to secure the region. Dalar Dawnweaver knows that hunting worgen across the forest will not end the danger. Their source lies inside Shadowfang Keep. You must breach the old stronghold, fight through Arugal’s worgen brood, and confront the mad wizard in his aerie. His severed head is proof of his death, and his defeat can break his hold over the region.

quest:1016.text: Elemental Bracers. At Silverwind Refuge, the night elves face tainted waters and seek the hand behind them. Sentinel Velene Starstrike asks you to gather intact bracers from the hostile elementals, so a divining scroll can identify who summoned them. Rogue water elementals now trouble Ashenvale’s sacred waters. Unlike the wild spirits that naturally inhabit the world, these creatures show signs of artificial conjuration. At Silverwind Refuge, the Sentinels see their sudden arrival as a sign that outside corruption is reaching deeper into the forest’s waterways. Sentinel Velene Starstrike believes someone deliberately bound and unleashed the elementals. She gives you a magical divining scroll to help identify the culprit. The spell needs a reagent tied to the summoned beings: intact bracers taken from the spirits before they dissipate. The scroll reads the lingering arcane signature on those bindings, tracing it to whoever called the elementals into being.

quest:1017.text: Mage Summoner. Sentinel Velene Starstrike sends a strike south from Silverwind Refuge. After investigating corrupted water elementals near Mystral Lake, the Sentinels send adventurers across the border into the Barrens to kill the undead mage Sarilus Foulborne atop Dreadmist Peak. Night elves rarely send scouts south into the Barrens without grave cause. After investigating unnatural disturbances among the water elementals around Mystral Lake, Sentinel Velene Starstrike traces the meddling to Sarilus Foulborne, a Forsaken conjurer practicing his arts just across the border. For the Sentinels at Silverwind Refuge, an enemy sorcerer defiling nature so close to their home cannot be tolerated. Sarilus Foulborne has made his lair high on Dreadmist Peak, a craggy mountain crawling with Burning Blade cultists. From there, he summons ranks of water elementals and bends them to his will, defying night elf authority from Horde lands. Reaching him means braving enemy territory and cutting through his summoned forces. The Sentinels demand his severed head as proof that their vengeance reaches beyond the forest line.

quest:1020.text: Orendil's Cure. In Ashenvale, Orendil's Cure is bound for a sick child in Astranaar. Orendil Broadleaf sends an Alliance traveler with a remedy made from rare flora. In Astranaar, Pelturas Whitemoon watches his daughter Relara waste away from a severe, mysterious sickness. With local knowledge exhausted, he sought help from herbalists across Ashenvale before hope faded. Orendil Broadleaf brews a draught to halt Relara's affliction from the necessary components, including Bathran's hair. He entrusts the cure to you and sends you south and east along the forest highway to Astranaar, where Relara awaits it.

quest:1021.text: Vile Satyr! Dryads in Danger!. Illiyana searches Ashenvale for her sisters, missing after setting out to recover a stolen relic. She asks travelers to find them in the corrupted ruins of Xavian. Dryad Illiyana waits in Ashenvale, overwhelmed with worry for her sisters. They left for the corrupted northern reaches of the forest to recover the Branch of Cenarius, a holy relic stolen by satyrs. They promised to return swiftly, but two days have passed without word. Now Illiyana asks passing Alliance travelers to track them down before it is too late.

quest:1022.text: The Howling Vale. At the Howling Vale, worgen have overrun a ruined shrine near Felwood. Sentinel Melyria Frostshadow seeks the cause of their arrival in Ashenvale. Worgen cries echo from a ruined shrine in northern Ashenvale. The shrine of Mel'Thandris lies beyond a cavern path near the Felwood border. Sentinel Melyria Frostshadow fears the worgen may bring another disaster to the woodland realm. Night elf sentinels are already spending great effort holding back demonic corruption from Felwood.

quest:1023.text: Raene's Cleansing. At Lake Falathim, Raene's Cleansing turns from a search for Teronis into a grim recovery. Raene Wolfrunner sent the night elf sentinel there, and now you must bring back his journal and a glowing gem held by the murlocs before reporting to her in Astranaar. Raene Wolfrunner sent you to Lake Falathim to find Teronis, a night elf sentinel. You find him dead beside the water. His belongings include an intact journal, with an account of his assignment and what he found about Ashenvale's strange disturbances. Teronis tracked a rare, glowing stone to Lake Falathim, but the lake's aggressive murlocs now hold it. You need to recover the gem and Teronis' journal to continue the work he began.

quest:1024.text: Raene's Cleansing. A Glowing Gem brings Raene's Cleansing to a turning point in Ashenvale. Raene Wolfrunner sends you east of Iris Lake to ask the dryad Shael'dryn how Dartol's ancient rod can be restored. Raene Wolfrunner studies the field notes left by the sentinel Teronis, who died while investigating Ashenvale's troubled furbolgs. His research points to an ancient rod crafted by a night elf named Dartol. Raene has recovered a Glowing Gem, but her skill as a huntress cannot unravel the arcane and natural mysteries surrounding the relic. Raene sends you northeast toward Iris Lake to seek Shael'dryn, a dryad who dwells beside a moonwell. As one of the Daughters of Cenarius, Shael'dryn understands the forest and ancient relics. Bring her the Glowing Gem, and she may reveal what else is needed to restore Dartol's Rod.

quest:1025.text: An Aggressive Defense. Raene Wolfrunner sends Alliance defenders against the Foulweald furbolgs in Ashenvale. Corruption has made the tribe dangerous along the road east of Astranaar. Furbolgs now attack travelers on the road east from Astranaar toward the Falfarren River. Sentinel Raene Wolfrunner sends capable defenders to strike the Foulweald camps just south of the highway. The attacks have made this vital road through Ashenvale dangerous for anyone who travels it. The Foulweald were once friends and allies of the night elves. For ages, the kaldorei and furbolgs shared a reverence for nature and the wild gods. The Burning Legion's invasion left a taint that shattered many furbolg minds. Peaceful neighbors became violent reavers, and innocent travelers now face their attacks.

quest:1026.text: Raene's Cleansing. In Ashenvale, Raene's Cleansing brings Dartol's Rod closer to being whole. Shael'dryn knows where its iron shaft lies, in a chest near the Felwood border. The search leads toward treants changed by corruption. Raene Wolfrunner sends you to Shael'dryn, a keeper who watches over a moonwell deep in Ashenvale. Shael'dryn knows where Dartol's Rod's iron shaft lies, but reaching it means facing the taint spreading through the northern woods. The shaft is locked in an old chest in a quiet glade near the Felwood border. A wooden key is needed to open the chest, and Crazed and Withered Ancients hold it. These treants wander the mountain road north toward Felwood, their natural harmony shattered by corruption spreading south from the demonic wastes. Once guardians of the wild, they are now tormented and hostile, and the key lies with them.

quest:1027.text: Raene's Cleansing. In Ashenvale, Raene Wolfrunner and Shael'dryn seek Dartol's Rod's final piece. They hope the relic can help cleanse the forest and slow the furbolg attacks on its night elves. The iron pommel of Dartol's Rod was entrusted to the night elf druids at Dor'Danil barrow den. Disaster struck the sanctuary, and its caretakers were slain. With their refuge overrun, the pommel's hiding place was lost. Scavengers and wandering oozes now consume what remains in the ruins east of the southern road. Dartol was an evil wizard who has since died, but the rod he made holds transformative powers. Raene Wolfrunner and Shael'dryn seek to reassemble it, hoping it can help slow the furbolg attacks on Ashenvale's night elves. The iron pommel is the final piece Shael'dryn needs before she can try to mend the fractured rod at the moonwell.

quest:1028.text: Raene's Cleansing. At Shael'dryn's direction, Raene's Cleansing now leads you to a mountain shrine with the rebuilt Rod of Dartol. The basin there holds the magic needed to restore its enchantment. Shael'dryn sends you from her moonwell into Ashenvale's wild southeastern slopes. The ancient shrines of Ashenvale often stood high among mountain crags, far from roads and hidden beneath dense forest canopies. You must cross unmarked ground along the rock faces and climb winding trails known mostly to Sentinels and woodland hermits. A stone basin waits in a quiet forest alcove. Though dormant, the shrine holds protective magic placed there by night elves long ago. Rest the rebuilt Rod of Dartol in the basin, and the shrine's sleeping power awakens. Its magic flows into the rod, restoring its enchantment so it can cleanse the land.

quest:1029.text: Raene's Cleansing. At Iris Lake, Shael'dryn entrusts you with Dartol's Rod of Transformation, restored for Raene Wolfrunner in Astranaar. You carry it back to report success and honor Teronis, the fallen scout. Dartol's Rod of Transformation has been reforged with components and ancient gem fragments gathered from corrupted reaches of Ashenvale. Near Iris Lake, the dryad Shael'dryn cleanses and renews its magic, then sends you across the forest roads to Astranaar. Raene Wolfrunner awaits the restored artifact.

quest:1030.text: Raene's Cleansing. In Ashenvale, Raene Wolfrunner seeks a way to speak with an uncorrupted furbolg. Southeast of Mystral Lake, Krolg offers a rare glimpse of the surviving furbolgs’ resentment toward the night elves. Raene Wolfrunner believes the late night elf meant to use Dartol’s restored Rod of Transformation to approach the furbolgs in disguise. Ashenvale’s woods have grown perilous, and madness spreads through the tribes, leaving no path to direct diplomacy. The rod gives you the shape of a furbolg, so you can try to pass their territorial rage and find someone willing to speak.

quest:1031.text: The Branch of Cenarius. In eastern Ashenvale, Anilia's final plea sends you after the Branch of Cenarius. Geltharis has taken the sacred relic, and Illiyana waits for its return. You find Anilia near death while searching eastern Ashenvale for missing dryads. The wounded daughter of Cenarius points north, toward the satyr ruins. With her last breaths, she names Geltharis as the one who took the Branch of Cenarius and begs you to recover it. Geltharis hides among the ancient elven ruins of Xavian. The satyrs are ancient servants of the Burning Legion, and they prize relics tied to Cenarius as trophies to defile and mock. Taking the branch from Geltharis can answer Anilia's plea and help defend Ashenvale's sacred plants from the corruption these servants spread.

quest:1032.text: Satyr Slaying!. At the Shrine of Aessina, Illiyana asks Alliance champions to strike at the satyrs of Ashenvale. Grieving her sister Anilia, she seeks vengeance and asks you to bring back satyr horns as proof. Anilia's death has left Illiyana in grief at the Shrine of Aessina. Dryads are forest spirits bonded to nature, often playful and serene, and elusive to mortals. Anilia's brutal slaying shattered that calm for her sister. Illiyana now turns to Alliance travelers to strike down the demonic beasts responsible. Satyrs were once night elves, but demonic energy corrupted them during the War of the Ancients. They lurk in defiled groves across Ashenvale and prey on the woods' inhabitants as servants of the Burning Legion. Bringing Illiyana their horns gives proof of vengeance and strikes at the fel presence encroaching on eastern Ashenvale.

quest:1033.text: Elune's Tear. In Astranaar, Pelturas Whitemoon seeks a cure for his ailing daughter, Relara. The brew made from Bathran's hair slowed her sickness, but did not cleanse it. He asks you to bring Elune's Tear from Iris Lake, hoping its sacred power can drive the corruption from her. Pelturas Whitemoon's young daughter, Relara, lies gravely ill in Astranaar. He hoped a draught made from Bathran's hair would heal her, but though Orendil Broadleaf's brew slowed the sickness, it did not clear it from her body. Ordinary remedies have not been enough. Pelturas now turns to the old traditions of his people and seeks a cure touched by divine cleansing light. Orendil Broadleaf named a stronger remedy in case the herbal brew failed: Elune's Tear, a sacred stone found on an island in Iris Lake, east of Astranaar. Night elves believe the stone bears the Moon Goddess's blessing and can purge corruption from the living. Troubled water elementals patrol the lake's shallows and banks, guarding its waters.

quest:1034.text: The Ruins of Stardust. In Astranaar, Pelturas Whitemoon still seeks a cure for his daughter Relara. Elune's Tear eased her nightmares, but a fierce fever grips her. Orendil Broadleaf sends him south for cooling stardust among ancient night elven stones. Pelturas Whitemoon keeps vigil beside his daughter, Relara, as a malignant illness burns through her. Elune's Tear brought her some relief from the nightmares, but the sickness remains. A fierce fever still racks her, beyond the reach of ordinary medicines. With the temple healers stretched thin, Pelturas turns to old remedies drawn from nature, hoping to save her life. Orendil Broadleaf, an elder herbalist, points Pelturas toward the Ruins of Stardust, south across the river from Astranaar. Frosted, shimmering dust settles on the plants among the fallen marble columns and archways of this ancient kaldorei sanctuary. The powder, called stardust, has a natural chill strong enough to draw out unnatural heat. Pelturas hopes to grind it into a poultice and ease Relara's fever. Water elementals and wildlife make gathering the frosted dust dangerous among the flooded stones. Elementals, corrupted or stirred by changes in Ashenvale's balance, surge around the sunken plazas where the bushes grow thickest. You wade into shallows that look calm, watching for ambushes from the murky depths. The sparkling bushes must yield enough clean dust to carry back to Astranaar.

quest:1035.text: Fallen Sky Lake. At Fallen Sky Lake, a moonstone may be the only hope for Relara, whose fever has broken but whose strength is nearly gone. Her father, Pelturas Whitemoon, sends you to the waters southeast of Astranaar, where a corrupted Shadethicket Oracle guards the fallen stones. Pelturas Whitemoon has watched his young daughter, Relara, slip closer to death through days of illness. Remedies made from Bathran's hair and stardust broke her raging fever, but left her body hollow and frail. Pelturas fears she has only breaths remaining before her spirit fades permanently into the night. Pelturas turns to moonstones to restore Relara's strength. These celestial fragments once fell into Fallen Sky Lake, southeast of Astranaar, and night elves gathered them for their healing power. Aggressive elementals or corrupted bark now claim the stones, so gathering one means facing danger with blade and spell.

quest:1037.text: Velinde Starsong. In Ashenvale, Melyria Frostshadow seeks word of the commander who came before her. Velinde Starsong vanished while fighting the corruption spreading from Felwood, and Melyria sends you to Darnassus for answers. Melyria Frostshadow keeps watch in Ashenvale, following Velinde Starsong, who once held the same post. A priestess, Velinde was charged with containing demonic corruption spreading south from Felwood. Early reports said she had the danger under control, but her campaign faltered over time. Then she vanished without warning or formal relief, leaving the fight unfinished and her fate unknown.

quest:1038.text: Velinde's Effects. In Darnassus, Velinde's Effects draw the Sentinels into an inquiry. The search concerns Sentinel Velinde Starsong, who vanished after years of service, and the journal Thyn'tel Bladeweaver asks you to retrieve from the Sentinels' quarters. Priestess Velinde Starsong served the night elves for many years and earned their deep trust. When she quietly vanished from her duties, the Sentinels believed she had left for personal reasons and expected her to return. Outsiders later found clues tied to the Tome of Mel'Thandris. Only then did Sentinel leaders allow an inquiry into Velinde's private belongings.

quest:1039.text: The Barrens Port. Thyn'tel Bladeweaver sends you from Darnassus to Ratchet to search for Velinde Starsong. The Sentinels believe she took a ship across the Great Sea to the Eastern Kingdoms, and her trail leads through dangerous Horde lands. Clues among Velinde Starsong's personal effects suggest she sought passage across the sea to the Eastern Kingdoms. Ratchet is the Barrens' only working harbor, where travelers from northern Kalimdor can arrange passage south or east without sailing from night elf lands. Thyn'tel Bladeweaver sends you south to search the harbor master's ledgers for Velinde's name. The road to Ratchet crosses the heart of Horde lands. South of Ashenvale, orc outriders and Tauren patrols range across the Mor'shan Rampart and the dry Barrens. Ratchet is governed by the neutral Steamwheedle Cartel, whose goblin law puts trade ahead of faction rivalries. At the docks, Wharfmaster Dizzywig records every passenger and cargo crate.

quest:104.text: The Coastal Menace. On Westfall's rocky shore, Captain Grayson's ghost calls travelers to face The Coastal Menace. His ship broke on the rocks after murlocs drove the lighthouse keeper's family from their post. The family returned, but Old Murk-Eye led another attack and killed them. Now Grayson seeks the chieftain's death and justice for the shore. The Westfall Lighthouse once guided ships through the jagged shallows along the southern coast. After murlocs frightened the lighthouse keeper's family from their post, Captain Grayson's ship struck the rocks in the dark. The family returned and lit the flame again, but danger still stalked the shore. Old Murk-Eye rallied the weaker-minded murlocs along the coast and led them against the lighthouse. In that second attack, the keeper's family died while Captain Grayson watched, helpless. Now the ghostly captain calls for Murk-Eye's death and asks for a scale as proof. He hopes to bring peace to the dead and protect sailors on the Great Sea.

quest:1040.text: Passage to Booty Bay. Wharfmaster Dizzywig’s records send the search for Velinde Starsong from Ratchet to Booty Bay. From there, Alliance travelers seek Ruzzgot, a goblin caravan driver. Wharfmaster Dizzywig’s records carry the search for night elf Sentinel Velinde Starsong from Ashenvale to the sea. In Ratchet, the goblin port, Dizzywig finds old shipping manifests showing that Velinde booked passage on the Black Osprey. The vessel was bound for Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale. A neutral goblin ferry crosses the Great Sea between Ratchet and the southern tip of the Eastern Kingdoms. In Booty Bay, the trail leads to Caravaneer Ruzzgot, a goblin transport master Dizzywig recommended to Velinde. She had asked about dangerous overland journeys through the southern wilderness.

quest:1041.text: The Caravan Road. In Booty Bay, the search for Velinde Starsong turns north toward Darkshire. Caravaneer Ruzzgot remembers the missing night elf priestess traveling with his caravan through Stranglethorn Vale. Caravaneer Ruzzgot remembers Velinde Starsong as a passenger on his caravan. The search for the missing night elf priestess has brought you from Ashenvale to Booty Bay, at the southern edge of Stranglethorn Vale. She traveled with his caravan through the jungle, an unusual journey for a night elf priestess. Ruzzgot says he and Velinde parted ways as they traveled north through Stranglethorn Vale. She set out toward Duskwood, and her trail leads to Darkshire. Clerk Daltry keeps the town's records, including the names of unfamiliar travelers who enter. His ledger may hold the next clue to Velinde's whereabouts.

quest:1042.text: The Carevin Family. In Darkshire, the search for Velinde Starsong brings strangers to the Carevin family. Clerk Daltry points them to the hunters after hearing of wolf-men in Ashenvale. The search for Velinde Starsong leads from Kalimdor’s ancient forests to Duskwood. In Darkshire, clerk Daltry finds no town record of an elven priestess staying there. But mention the savage wolf-men seen in Ashenvale, and he listens closely. Beasts like those have begun terrorizing the woods around town. The Carevin family hunts the horrors that trouble Duskwood. Known locally for tracking demons, undead, and other monsters, the family has already faced the wolf-men. Their tracker, Calor, recently hauled a grisly string of severed wolf-men heads through Darkshire’s streets. Clerk Daltry sends you to Jonathan Carevin, the stern head of the household, to learn what the hunters know about the worgen.

quest:1043.text: The Scythe of Elune. In Darkshire, the trail of the Scythe of Elune leads into the worgen hunt. Jonathan Carevin sends you to Roland's Doom, where the beasts were first seen, linking an ancient night elf relic in Kalimdor to the worgen now troubling Duskwood. After tracing Priestess Velinde Starsong across Kalimdor and speaking with the Carevin household in Darkshire, you find common cause with Jonathan Carevin. Nightbane worgen have overrun southern Duskwood, driving miners out and threatening what remains of the township. Carevin does not fully understand the beasts' supernatural origin, but he recognizes the value of someone willing to hunt them. He points you toward Roland's Doom, the mine where the fiends were first sighted.

quest:1045.text: Raene's Cleansing. At Lake Mystral, Krolg asks you to kill Ran Bloodtooth. Disguised by Dartol's Rod of Transformation, you can earn the uncorrupted furbolgs' trust. Krolg resents the night elves and fears the rot among his people. He wants the furbolgs to answer for their own. Near Lake Mystral, Krolg lives apart from the others, displaced and weary. He blames the night elves' ancient pride for the ruin brought upon Kalimdor and the dark rot spreading through Ashenvale. Dartol's Rod of Transformation lets you approach the furbolgs in disguise. Krolg hates the kaldorei, yet he calls for neither slaughter nor the deaths of innocents. Krolg believes his people must answer for their own deeds instead of yielding to the demonic taint gripping the tribes. The corruption did not give them their flaws; it magnified their worst impulses. Ran Bloodtooth shows the danger. Ruthless and hungry for power even before the taint, the chieftain embraced the darkness. Now he threatens elves and innocent beasts alike. Krolg will not let one furbolg speak for them all.

quest:1046.text: Raene's Cleansing. In Astranaar, Raene's Cleansing reaches its end as you return with Ran Bloodtooth's skull. The search began with Teronis and now leaves Ashenvale's furbolg threat diminished. After Ran Bloodtooth falls, Krolg sends you back to Astranaar. You carry the chieftain's severed skull to Sentinel Raene Wolfrunner, proof that the threat prowling the forest depths has been struck down.

quest:1050.text: Mythology of the Titans. In Ironforge, Librarian Mae Paledust seeks Mythology of the Titans, a book said to have rested in Tirisfal's old Monastery. Its study may show what the past can teach about the unknown ahead. Before trouble came to Lordaeron, the old Monastery in Tirisfal Glades kept a library of knowledge. Mae asks you to bring her a book called Mythology of the Titans. It is said to be there, and she hopes its study will uncover secrets of the past.

quest:1054.text: Culling the Threat. In Astranaar, fear grows as the Thistlefur furbolgs multiply to the north. Raene Wolfrunner calls for Dal Bloodclaw's death before the tribe can assault the town. Astranaar stands in the heart of Ashenvale, with danger close on every side. The Thistlefur furbolgs dwell just north of town. Once peaceful forest dwellers, they have fallen to madness and aggression, as have many of their kin. Sentinel scouts have watched their numbers swell over recent months. Now they fear a coordinated attack on Astranaar is only a matter of time. Raene Wolfrunner calls travelers to strike before the Thistlefur overrun Astranaar's modest palisades. Dal Bloodclaw leads the tribe, giving its members order and courage. The Sentinels ask for his skull, brought back to Astranaar. They hope his death will break the furbolgs' coordination and buy the beleaguered town precious time.

quest:1055.text: Raene's Cleansing. At the hidden shrine in Ashenvale, Raene's Cleansing reaches a turning point. The Rod of Transformation is assembled and its magic restored, and you must return it to Shael'dryn at her moonwell sanctuary. At the hidden shrine in Ashenvale, you have restored the Rod of Transformation. Its shaft, pommel, and glowing gem are joined, and the rod has been re-enchanted. Shael'dryn needs it for Raene's investigation of the furbolg attacks. Shael'dryn waits beside the forest moonwell, where she has guided the rod's restoration. You bring her the finished relic and confirm its magic has returned. Then the Sentinel defenders can take their next steps to protect their besieged homeland.

quest:1057.text: Reclaiming the Charred Vale. At Stonetalon Peak, Keeper Albagorm sends Alliance fighters to clear the Bloodfury harpies from the ruined Charred Vale. Their removal will open a path for druids and caretakers to begin healing the scorched land. South of Stonetalon Peak, the Charred Vale lies in ash and smoldering ruins where a lush alpine haven once stood. A mechanized logging and mining army swept through the sacred crags, stripping trees and setting uncontrolled fires. For the guardians around Stonetalon, ancient woodland lost to industrial greed is a wound they cannot ignore. Bloodfury harpies took hold in the ashes left by the mechanical fires. Opportunistic and vicious, they swarm the smoking lowlands, nest there, and aggressively ambush anyone who approaches the valley. Keeper Albagorm and his allies cannot walk the soil to sow seeds of renewal; the harpies violently bar passage to every outsider. Restoration cannot begin until the Bloodfury roosts are broken. Albagorm sends seasoned Alliance fighters deep among the tribe to slay its hunters, ambushers, and roguefeathers. Thinning their predatory flock is the first step toward reclaiming the land for nature and giving the forest spirits room to breathe once more.

quest:1058.text: Jin'Zil's Forest Magic. At small Malaka'jin, Witch Doctor Jin'Zil holds three night elven scouts in crude iron cages. He sends Horde adventurers to Stonetalon Peak for wilderness reagents to brew a grim forest magic. Under the Horde's watch, Witch Doctor Jin'Zil practices his craft in Malaka'jin's red-rock defile. When three night elf captives fall into his hands, he chooses a mocking ritual made for his woodland foes instead of ordinary butchery. He sends travelers north into the peaks for thick tree sap, feline whiskers from predatory twilight runners, a shimmering fey dragon scale, and scores of eyes from the local forest coursers.

quest:1059.text: Reclaiming the Charred Vale. Keeper Albagorm seeks help for the Charred Vale from far to the south. The Bloodfury harpies have been driven back for now, but the wounded land needs more than force to heal. The Charred Vale lies beneath ash in southern Stonetalon Mountains, scarred by terrible destruction. Alliance forces under Keeper Albagorm have driven the Bloodfury harpies from their nests in the ruins, but their retreat may not last. Albagorm knows that force can only hold the harpies back. The ravaged earth must be healed before they return and take the Vale again. The grove tenders need help beyond their own means to restore the scorched land. Albagorm sends you south, past the salt flats and canyons of Thousand Needles, to Thalanaar on the border of Feralas. Falfindel Waywarder waits there. The night elf druid is known for a rare gift: calling on ancient forest spirits to bring life back to dead soil.

quest:106.text: Young Lovers. Maybell Maclure loves Tommy Joe Stonefield, though their families are bitter rivals. She asks you to carry her letter to him by the river. The Stonefields and the Maclures have held their grudge for years in southern Elwynn's farm country. Maybell cannot visit Tommy Joe without stirring her family's anger. So she trusts travelers to carry her letters across the line between the two farms. Tommy Joe stays beyond his relatives' sight on the quiet riverbank just west of Stonefield Farm. A letter from Maybell brings relief and fresh longing. Being apart grows more than he can bear, and the pair begin seeking ways to meet in secret.

quest:1060.text: Letter to Jin'Zil. Darsok Swiftdagger sends you from the northern Barrens into Stonetalon Mountains with news for his old friend, Witch Doctor Jin'Zil. Serena Bloodfeather has fallen, and Darsok wants Jin'Zil to know. Darsok Swiftdagger sends you into Stonetalon Mountains after Serena Bloodfeather falls. The Witchwing and Bloodfeather broods came from the rugged ridges northwest of the northern Barrens, not the scrublands. Now that you have defeated Serena, Darsok asks you to carry the news of her death to his old acquaintance, Witch Doctor Jin'Zil. Jin'Zil lives at the troll settlement of Malaka'jin, in the dangerous mountain peaks.

quest:1066.text: Blood of Innocents. Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill seeks blood for a plan against the Venture Company in Stonetalon Mountains. The Royal Apothecary Society uses dark ingredients gathered from local bandits to pacify the encroaching company. The Horde faces a steady struggle in the Stonetalon Mountains, where the Venture Company ravages the wilderness and its people. Apothecary Lydon proposes an alchemical remedy instead of sending armies to blunt their axes. He plans to brew an agent that paralyzes and pacifies the mercenaries, leaving them weak and docile. Apothecary Lydon needs a rare and troubling ingredient: the blood of innocents. He avoids sending Horde agents to kill innocents himself and instead turns to the crimes of the Syndicate. Fallen nobles and cutthroats occupy Durnholde Keep, where rogue shadow mages harvest innocent blood for profane rituals. Lydon makes those mages his target for alchemical supplies.

quest:1067.text: Return to Thunder Bluff. Apothecary Lydon’s toxin is bound for Thunder Bluff, where Zamah awaits it. She needs the formula to make a device that can spread it against the Venture Company. Apothecary Lydon has made the toxin from the ingredients gathered in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He wants to see it tested on living subjects, but the liquid needs a way to spread it. You carry the vial across the Great Sea to Mulgore, where Apothecary Zamah waits for it.

quest:1068.text: Shredding Machines. In Windshear Crag, the Venture Company’s shredders wound Stonetalon’s spirits. Seereth Stonebreak hears their cries as XT:4 and XT:9 tear through the forest. Orc shaman Seereth Stonebreak is stationed along the dusty border between the Barrens and the Stonetalon Mountains. She listens to the unseen realm, though chaos drowns out much of Stonetalon’s spiritual voice. One vision came through with harrowing clarity: man-shaped contraptions tearing through ancient woods with unnatural haste. Marked XT:4 and XT:9, the goblin-engineered shredders butcher Windshear Crag’s timberlands and send waves of distress through the surrounding nature spirits. The Venture Company operates in Windshear Crag, northwest of Greatwood Vale. To stem the devastation, Horde champions venture there and track down the logging constructs. Wrecking XT:4 and XT:9 deals a sharp blow to the mountains’ commercial deforestation and calms the immediate cries of wounded tree spirits. Seereth warns that unless the Venture Company abandons Stonetalon entirely, far darker atrocities await the land.

quest:1069.text: Deepmoss Spider Eggs. Mebok Mizzyrix sees a chance to sell Deepmoss Spider Eggs to Booty Bay. Spider egg omelettes have become a craze there, and he sends travelers into the Stonetalon Mountains to gather fresh clutches for the overseas trade. Booty Bay’s wealthy patrons and eccentric pirates have taken to spider egg omelettes, driving demand for rare ingredients across the Great Sea. Ratchet merchant Mebok Mizzyrix sees a chance to make a fortune by supplying the southern port. The Eastern Kingdoms have no supply of these spiders, so Mebok looks to Kalimdor’s wilderness for the eggs. Deepmoss spider eggs lie in the Stonetalon Mountains, where the Venture Company has cut timber. You can find clutches beneath the trees still standing at Windshear Crag, or farther into the web covered depths of Sishir Canyon. Gathering them means facing venomous bites and thick infestations. Even seasoned scavengers may find the swarms hard to stomach. Fresh eggs must cross the sea before they spoil or hatch. Mebok works with Ratchet’s Wharfmaster Dizzywig to book freight on goblin merchant ships bound for the docks of Stranglethorn Vale. Once the eggs are packed into crates, Mebok earns a tidy profit from the high seas trade in fine food.

quest:107.text: Note to William. "Note to William" is an errand undertaken for Gramma Stonefield in southern Elwynn Forest to help two secret lovers from feuding families. By delivering Mildred's message to the apothecary William Pestle in Goldshire, adventurers seek an alchemical solution to unite young Maybell and Tommy Joe. The Stonefield and Maclure families have lived as neighbors in southern Elwynn Forest for years, yet their bitter feuding has made normal relations impossible. Caught squarely in the middle are young Tommy Joe Stonefield and Maybell Maclure, whose romance must be conducted in utter secrecy. While their parents harbor relentless resentment, Gramma Mildred Stonefield takes pity on the young lovers and seeks an unconventional remedy to unite them. Believing that mundane persuasion will never sway the feuding families, Gramma Stonefield dispatches a courier north to the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire. Her message seeks out William Pestle, an experienced alchemist and apothecary whom Mildred has known for many years. Taking the missive in hand, William is moved by the plight of Maybell and Tommy Joe, resolving to put his alchemical knowledge to work on their behalf.

quest:1070.text: On Guard in Stonetalon. In Ashenvale, Sentinel Thenysil sends travelers south to check on Kaela Shadowspear. The scout went into Stonetalon to watch Venture Company incursions with a gnome mage, but word from her has fallen silent. In Astranaar, Sentinel Thenysil watches for threats pressing toward the ancient forest. Her friend Kaela Shadowspear went into the Stonetalon Mountains at Sentinel Wolfrunner’s order, to survey turmoil in the heights. Thenysil asks passing Alliance champions to find Kaela; no word has come, and she fears for her friend’s safety. Kaela’s companion is a gnome mage assigned by Alliance leaders. The night elves joined the Grand Alliance for strategic reasons, but many Sentinels distrust arcane practitioners and gnome tinkers in the wilderness. Kaela keeps an outpost on the bluffs above Windshear Crag, where she watches the Venture Company’s widespread devastation.

quest:1071.text: A Gnome's Respite. At Windshear Crag, Gaxim Rustfizzle struggles to slow the Venture Company's push into the forest. He asks travelers to drive back its workers so he can prepare new defenses. Gaxim Rustfizzle represents the Enlightened Assembly of Arcanology, Alchemy and Engineering Sciences. Among Stonetalon's ancient groves, he is meant to show the nature-worshipping night elves that gnomish invention can protect their threatened lands. He combines magic, chemical brews and mechanics, but the Venture Company's relentless pace leaves him little time to build defensive devices. Gaxim sends travelers into the smoking works at Windshear Crag to turn back the Venture Co. Loggers and Deforesters. Their retreat would give him time to organize his workshop and devise his next defense: controlled, strategic high explosives.

quest:1072.text: An Old Colleague. In the Stonetalon Mountains, Gaxim Rustfizzle seeks a powerful device and the means to fuel it. The gnome engineer sends you across the sea to Ironforge, where his old acquaintance Lomac Gearstrip can make a hazardous explosive compound called Nitromirglyceronium. In the Stonetalon Mountains, Gaxim Rustfizzle plans his most ambitious engineering work yet. A mechanism of that scale needs fuel stronger than ordinary gunpowder or crude oil. He needs Nitromirglyceronium, also called NG-5, an explosive mix potent enough to ensure destruction if all goes according to plan. Only one person Gaxim knows can refine NG-5: his old acquaintance Lomac Gearstrip. Lomac lives far to the east, in Tinker Town, the gnome quarter deep inside Ironforge. You make the long journey as Gaxim's courier, but Lomac greets you with immediate suspicion and paranoid questions.

quest:1073.text: Ineptitude + Chemicals = Fun. Across the sea, Alliance adventurers reach Ironforge seeking an explosive answer to the Venture Company in Stonetalon. Lomac Gearstrip agrees to brew Nitromirglyceronium if you bring him the needed alchemical reagents. Gaxim Rustfizzle needs powerful explosives for his most advanced device against the Venture Company. He is stationed high in the craggy passes of the Stonetalon Mountains, far from his eccentric former colleague Lomac Gearstrip in Ironforge. Lomac created Nitromirglyceronium, a compound so unstable and destructive that he finds the thought of anyone using it hilarious, no matter who gets blown apart. Lomac is eager to see goblin machinery, and perhaps you, blown to pieces, but his Ironforge workshop has run out of Nitromirglyceronium. Before brewing another batch, he asks for Minor Mana Potions and Elixirs of Minor Fortitude. The draughts supply the raw reagents for his mixture, and gathering them lets Lomac judge whether you have even a shred of respect for alchemy.

quest:1074.text: Ineptitude + Chemicals = Fun. Lomac Gearstrip sends volatile NG-5 to Gaxim Rustfizzle in the Stonetalon Mountains. Gaxim needs the chemical to ignite several wagons packed with dynamite, creating a distraction for Alliance operations in the disputed crags. Lomac Gearstrip hands over Nitromirglyceronium, or NG-5, an unstable compound born of gnomish engineering. He warns you to handle it with extreme care. Mishandled, the chemical could blow you to pieces on the road back to Gaxim Rustfizzle.

quest:1075.text: A Scroll from Mauren. Gaxim Rustfizzle seeks a spell from Collin Mauren in Stormwind's Mage Quarter. He needs arcane help to trigger his NG-5 explosives from afar. Mechanical fuses cannot give Gaxim the control he needs. He wants to ignite the charges with one button while he stays beyond the blast. Arcane magic may carry a command from his hand to the explosives. Collin Mauren is a human spellcaster with practical knowledge of the arcane. He considers how to bind an explosive ignition to a distant command. Then he begins the incantation Gaxim needs for his dangerous project.

quest:1076.text: Devils in Westfall. Dust devils roam Westfall, and Collin Mauren needs their remains for a spell. The Mage Quarter wizard is helping Gaxim Rustfizzle with an unusual experiment. Their work calls for a messaging scroll, and the dust holds what Mauren needs to enchant it. Collin Mauren is preparing a messaging scroll for Gaxim Rustfizzle. The wizard is helping the tinkerer with an unusual venture, but the spell needs more than ink and vellum. Dust devils roam Westfall with elemental magic swirling within them. Their remains provide the volatile medium Mauren needs to bind Gaxim's spell to parchment. Westfall was once Stormwind's fertile breadbasket. Drought, banditry, and neglect have left its fields arid and wild. Dust devils roam there, threatening travelers and lone homesteaders. Their residue holds the focused elemental essence Mauren needs to complete the enchantment.

quest:1077.text: Special Delivery for Gaxim. In Stonetalon, Gaxim Rustfizzle awaits a scroll from Stormwind. Collin Mauren provides the Scroll of Messaging, whose arcane power is needed to build a remote explosive against the Venture Company's deforestation. Gaxim Rustfizzle seeks to hinder the Venture Company's destructive work in the Stonetalon Mountains. He has made an explosive compound called NG-5, but lacks a reliable way to set it off from afar. Rather than use crude fuses, Gaxim enlisted help across the Great Sea. He contacted Collin Mauren in Stormwind's Mage Quarter to obtain an enchanted Scroll of Messaging.

quest:1078.text: Retrieval for Mauren. In Stormwind, Collin Mauren asks travelers bound for Kalimdor to bring him rare basilisk scales. He wants scales from the Charred Vale in Stonetalon to grind into dust for his spellcraft. Collin Mauren, a wizard in Stormwind's Mage Quarter, listens to tales from wandering adventurers. He has heard that travelers are venturing deep into Kalimdor, where Stonetalon draws those seeking wild wyverns, unruly elementals, or deals and clashes with the Venture Company. Mauren is not after riches or glory. He wants to learn what rare natural wonders survive in the region's harshest corners. The Charred Vale lies deep in Stonetalon, an ash-choked basin scarred by the Venture Company's devastation. Mauren's studies say a peculiar breed of basilisk once lived there. Their scales, crushed to a fine powder, can catalyze specialized arcane spells he has developed. He does not know whether the basilisks survived the Vale's harsh transformation, so he asks explorers to bring back fresh crystallised scales and learn whether the breed endures.

quest:1079.text: Covert Ops - Alpha. Alliance agents work under Gaxim Rustfizzle in the Stonetalon Mountains. From the peaks, they enter the Venture Company lumber mill in Windshear Crag to recover engineering schematics. Gaxim Rustfizzle directs a covert effort from Windshear Crag against the Venture Company's aggressive logging. Goblin loggers cut timber south of Cragpool Lake, but destruction alone cannot stop them. Plan Alpha sends agents past the loggers and overseers to take the mill's technical schematics. The Venture Company's schematics interest gnomes for more than the night elves' forests. The plans show how goblin loggers, mechanical cutters and mechanized transports work. Alliance engineers can use them to find structural flaws and break up future operations, while adapting goblin designs for their own projects in Ironforge.

quest:1080.text: Covert Ops - Beta. In the Stonetalon Mountains, Gaxim Rustfizzle sends an agent into the Venture Company’s mine. Explosives will draw the goblins away while the agent takes letters that reveal the company’s plans and help defend the Sentinels’ lands. After the first blows against the Venture Company’s logging at Windshear Crag, Gaxim Rustfizzle turns to the company’s supply heart. The plan follows the same pattern as before: an explosive diversion scatters goblin workers and mercenaries while an agent searches the mine for written orders and records. At the eastern edge of Windshear Crag, Windshear Mine is the Venture Company’s base beneath the mountain. Its goblins dig for rock and cut timber, keeping records of supply routes and orders from their leaders. An agent slips inside, sets Gaxim’s explosive packs, and takes the Venture Co. Letters. The blast disrupts the mine’s guard, and the letters reveal more of the company’s plans in Kalimdor. Gaxim takes pleasure in clever devices and explosions, but the work also matters to the night elves. In Stonetalon, the Sentinels face the Horde as well as the companies cutting and digging through their lands. Letters from the mine give commanders such as Kaela Shadowspear information they can use to anticipate threats to the sacred woods.

quest:1081.text: Reception from Tyrande. Sentinel Thenysil sends you from Astranaar to Darnassus for an audience with Tyrande Whisperwind. After you help the Sentinels hold their ground against the Venture Company in Stonetalon, Tyrande receives you at the Temple of the Moon. The Venture Company puts pressure on night elf outposts across the Stonetalon Mountains. Sentinel Thenysil coordinates the defense from Astranaar, but the remote bases are hard to sustain. Supply lines and intelligence help the Sentinels keep an Alliance presence in Kalimdor's interior, and your aid strengthens their position. After your help bolsters the Sentinels in Stonetalon, Sentinel Thenysil sends you back to Teldrassil. Tyrande Whisperwind, the High Priestess, grants you an audience at the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. She recognizes your deeds across Kalimdor and welcomes you as an ally fighting alongside the kaldorei.

quest:1082.text: Update for Sentinel Thenysil. Word of relief travels from Stonetalon to Astranaar. After helping Kaela Shadowspear and Gaxim Rustfizzle against the Venture Company, you are sent to reassure Sentinel Tara Thenysil that their outpost still holds. Stonetalon's jagged passes leave the night elf frontier isolated and exposed. The Venture Company cuts down the crags and pollutes the waterways, threatening the outpost where Kaela Shadowspear and the gnome tinkerer Gaxim Rustfizzle serve. With the immediate danger blunted, Kaela sends you northeast across the border into Ashenvale to report that they remain safe. In Astranaar, Sentinel Tara Thenysil watches Ashenvale's interior roads and worries over scouts sent into harsher lands. Word that Kaela and her engineering partner are alive and working to heal the land brings welcome relief. The report shows that, despite dwindling forces and threats on several fronts, cooperation with Alliance allies can slow the destruction.

quest:1083.text: Enraged Spirits. In the Charred Vale, spirits of flame and stone rage after the Venture Company’s destruction. Fire and heavy machinery laid waste to the basin, and the freed elementals overran it. Alliance champions are asked to quell them so the wounded land may heal under Elune’s grace. The Charred Vale was once a lush haven in Stonetalon. The Venture Company’s greed turned it to ash as goblins drove to log the forest and strip its resources. They used incendiary devices and heavy machinery, setting the canopy ablaze. Their actions destroyed the trees and shattered the fragile elemental balance beneath the earth. The Venture Company’s work stirred ancient spirits of fire, stone, and fury from the depths. The enraged elementals turned on the goblins, drove them back, and claimed the smoldering crater. Kaela Shadowspear says nature cannot begin to recover while these chaotic elementals remain.

quest:1084.text: Wounded Ancients. In the Stonetalon Mountains, the treants have turned against the land they once guarded. Kaela Shadowspear suspects goblin munitions are to blame and asks you to recover shrapnel from the corrupted guardians for Gaxim Rustfizzle to examine. The treants once guarded the groves of Stonetalon, gentle yet fierce, bound to the health of the land. When the Venture Company arrived with buzzsaws, explosives, and strip-mining, the forest fought back. The treants drove the invaders from parts of the vale, but their victory came at a cost. They did not return to their peaceful watch. Instead, they became hostile and maddened. Kaela Shadowspear, an Alliance scout in the mountains, believes the treants suffer from no natural sickness. Gaxim Rustfizzle, a gnome engineer, suspects the goblins' weapons and chemicals harmed them during the Venture Company's chaotic retreat. He hopes to learn whether Venture Company ordnance is poisoning Stonetalon's ancient protectors by studying corroded shrapnel from the wounded treants.

quest:1085.text: On Guard in Stonetalon. At a camp near Windshear Crag, Kaela Shadowspear sends Alliance travelers to Gaxim Rustfizzle for help against the Venture Company. The cautious night elf sentinel and eccentric gnome tinkerer join forces to guard the mountain pass from the company's rampant despoilment. In the crags of Stonetalon Mountains, the rapacious Venture Company cuts into wilderness and fells ancient trees. Kaela Shadowspear, a night elf sentinel, sees that martial skill alone cannot stop its industrialized pillaging. She turns to gnome ingenuity, though night elves and gnomes rarely agree on technology or the natural world. Their unlikely alliance shows how precarious the struggle has become. Gaxim Rustfizzle brings the eccentric pragmatism of the Alliance's smaller allies. Night elf society turned away from arcane excess millennia ago, but Gaxim believes that abstaining from magic and technical innovation leaves the night elves vulnerable. He hopes to convince his Kaldorei hosts that practical science can defend nature as well as bow and glaive.

quest:1086.text: The Flying Machine Airport. Apothecary Zamah sends you to silence The Flying Machine Airport above Stonetalon. Carry her Toxic Fogger into the Venture Company’s logging grounds and strike at the cartel’s link to the outside world. Apothecary Zamah prepares Apothecary Lydon’s toxin for the Venture Company. The tauren seek to protect Stonetalon from deforestation and ravaging machinery, while the Forsaken answer with a different approach. Zamah targets the cartel’s connection beyond the mountains instead of its foot soldiers or loggers. A rumored copter pad carries light cargo and messages between Stonetalon and distant corporate offices. The Venture Company’s copter pad sits high in the Cragpool Lake area, south of the great waterwheel. The small platform serves lightweight flying machines, not massive zeppelins. You are sent to set off the Toxic Fogger there, filling the pad with toxic vapor before a pilot, courier, or mechanic can alert the company’s commanders.

quest:1087.text: Cenarius' Legacy. Near Sun Rock Retreat, Cenarius' Legacy turns Braelyn Firehand's grievance into a call to arms. The blood elf mage says the night elves and Cenarius's children suppress the land's magic. She wants them culled at Stonetalon Peak so raw arcane power can flow freely, while their defeat weakens the Alliance presence in the mountains. Braelyn Firehand lives in the hills near Sun Rock Retreat, frustrated by Stonetalon's natural wards. She says the druids of the Cenarion Circle and the offspring of the demigod Cenarius choke the land's arcane currents. To Braelyn, channeling power here is like drawing water with a perforated bucket. She wants to strip away those defenses and let raw magical energy surge freely again. Braelyn sends Horde champions north to Stonetalon Peak to break the wardens' hold. Ancient kaldorei groves and temple grounds there are patrolled by Cenarion Botanists and the proud Sons and Daughters of Cenarius. Striking them down would weaken the wards that muffle Braelyn's spellcraft. It would also deal a bloody blow to the night elf enclave that threatens the Horde's foothold in the mountains.

quest:1088.text: Ordanus. At Sunrock Retreat, Braelyn Firehand uses arcane sight to hunt Keeper Ordanus, an elder son of Cenarius who fled Stonetalon Peak. She believes his people desecrated ancient Highborne ruins, so she sends Horde champions across the border into Ashenvale to take his head. Braelyn Firehand came to Stonetalon Mountains on her master's orders to reclaim the sacred ruins of Azshara's ancient temples. She found night elves already at the peak, treating relics of her Highborne forebears as wilderness to be contained. Her chief target, Keeper Ordanus, escaped before she could corner him and crossed into Ashenvale. Braelyn used arcane vision to find his hiding place high in a wooden refuge at Raynewood Retreat, then enlisted the Horde to finish the hunt. Among Cenarius's sons, Keeper Ordanus is counted as one of the eldest, with deep ties to Kalimdor's wild magics. Night elf guardians moved him from Stonetalon Peak to Raynewood Retreat to shield him from arcane forces encroaching on sacred groves. Loyal Cenarion Vindicators and summoned woodland treants defend him. For Braelyn, the keeper carries the forest demigod's ancient authority and blocks her vengeance.

quest:1089.text: The Den. Braelyn Firehand sends Horde champions into the Talon Den's hidden barrow chambers to seize the druids' relics. This infiltration campaign reaches its climax as they face layered defenses beneath Stonetalon Peak. High on the Stonetalon Mountains, the Talon Den shelters night elf druids in halls carved deep into living stone. The barrow chambers protect meditating guardians and keep sacred treasures from prying eyes. Knowing the value of what lies within, Braelyn Firehand questions a captured druid to learn how the defenses work.

quest:1090.text: Gerenzo's Orders. At the Venture Company dig site in Stonetalon, Piznik works against his new boss, Gerenzo. The ousted goblin hopes to expose the ore operation by digging a sample while an ally guards him from camp patrols. At Windshear Crag, the Venture Company rewards ruthlessness over loyalty. Piznik once served as second-in-command at the excavation, until Gerenzo seized power, fired supervisor Ziz Fizziks, and sent Piznik back to the mines with a pick. Piznik did not leave. Under Ziz's instructions, he stayed on as an informant, watching Gerenzo's every move and waiting for a chance to strike back at the supervisor who displaced him. Gerenzo's takeover springs from an obsession with a strange gold-green ore in the Stonetalon rock. He believes the mineral is worth an extraordinary sum, and has ordered miners to tear it from the earth in huge quantities. Ziz Fizziks has a mysterious new employer who may pay well for news of the venture. Piznik risks discovery to dig out a sample, relying on an ally to hold off aggressive diggers, vermin, and overseers policing the operation.

quest:1091.text: Kaela's Update. Gaxim Rustfizzle sends you back to Kaela Shadowspear with letters taken from the Venture Company. Their contents help the Sentinels follow the goblin cartel's work in Stonetalon. Gaxim Rustfizzle sends you back to Kaela Shadowspear with captured letters. After you helped the gnome mage uncover Venture Company movements, he gathered correspondence detailing the cartel's operations. Kaela, a night elf Sentinel coordinator near Windshear Crag, is waiting for the letters. Gaxim also wants you to mention how his magic helped the investigation. The Sentinels watch Stonetalon's crags with concern. Horde forces contest the lower trails, while the Venture Company cuts trees and mines the land. Its letters give Kaela a look at the cartel's communications and help the Alliance plan its defenses along the ridges.

quest:1092.text: Gerenzo's Orders. Piznik sends Gerenzo's Orders ore sample to Ziz Fizziks, his contact beyond the dig site. The delivery closes a dangerous act of espionage inside the Venture Company workings at Windshear Crag. Piznik's cover at Windshear Crag is blown, and he knows he cannot stay with the Venture Company crew. Management in Undermine punishes sabotage within its ranks, so the nervous goblin arranges to slip away and find another employer. Before he goes, he gives an outsider the Unidentified Ore mined under Gerenzo's orders. The specimen must reach its destination without drawing suspicion to Piznik.

quest:1093.text: Super Reaper 6000. At Windshear Crag, Ziz Fizziks seeks favor with his new boss, Sputtervalve. He wants the Venture Company’s plans for a great woodcutting machine designed by his rival, Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle. At Windshear Crag, the Venture Trading Company cuts deep into the Stonetalon Mountains to feed its logging operation. Ziz Fizziks, a goblin engineer recently cast out of the company, now works for Sputtervalve. He hopes to prove his worth to his new boss by taking the plans for the company’s massive automated woodcutting machine, the Super Reaper 6000.

quest:1094.text: Further Instructions. Ziz Fizziks sends stolen Venture Company plans from Windshear Crag to Ratchet. The documents may give his rival Sputtervalve an edge. After the Venture Company cast Ziz Fizziks out of its logging operations at Windshear Crag, he took sensitive documents, internal manuals, and technical schematics with him. Bitter over his dismissal, he sealed them in an envelope bound for Ratchet. Among the papers are blueprints for the experimental Super Reaper 6000. Fizziks hopes to find a buyer or ally willing to use what he stole. Sputtervalve, an engineer, waits in the neutral port of Ratchet in the Barrens. He has little affection or trust for Fizziks, but the rivalry with the Venture Company makes the offer hard to refuse. The Steamwheedle-aligned goblins seek ways to weaken their ruthless competitor and eagerly reverse-engineer superior mechanical inventions they encounter.

quest:1095.text: Further Instructions. Sputtervalve carries an order from Undermine to Ziz Fizziks in the Stonetalon Mountains. Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle, the gnome engineer hired by Mogul Razdunk, must be eliminated. The Venture Company’s hiring of Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle has stirred trouble among Undermine’s rulers. Mogul Razdunk brought the gnome engineer into the company, and word of it reached the Trade Princes. Director Riddlevox told Sputtervalve to intervene quietly. Sputtervalve believes the order comes from the highest trade authorities, so he passes the work to Ziz Fizziks, the operative nearest the scene.

quest:1096.text: Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle. High above Cragpool Lake, Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle awaits a bounty in the Stonetalon Mountains. The rogue gnome overseer has replaced much of his decaying flesh with gears, clockwork machinery, and artificial limbs. Ziz Fizziks wants his mechanical arm as proof of his death, hoping it will win him a promotion. Gerenzo’s body bears the marks of his transformations. Those who have seen him say his natural flesh is rotting beneath grafted gears, iron plating, and whirring clockwork limbs. He watches operations from near the great water wheel above Cragpool Lake, with no concern for his failing flesh. Ziz Fizziks works for Sputtervalve and hopes Gerenzo’s fall will carry him out of Stonetalon. Ziz cannot climb the cliffs and defeat the augmented overseer himself, so he asks you to bring back Gerenzo’s mechanical arm. With it, he hopes to prove his worth and earn a transfer to the Tinkers’ Union workshops in Gadgetzan or Undermine. Gerenzo’s mechanical arm reflects a sharp divide between gnome and goblin engineering. He cut away failing flesh to make room for complex prosthetics, a choice goblins find baffling. As Ziz sees it, goblin ingenuity would keep the natural limb and add an explosive third arm beside it.

quest:1098.text: Deathstalkers in Shadowfang. In Shadowfang Keep, Deathstalkers Adamant and Vincent have gone missing. High Executor Hadrec sends Horde adventurers inside to find the reconnaissance agents. Their intelligence is needed to prepare a Forsaken assault against Archmage Arugal and his worgen packs. Silverpine Forest remains contested, and Archmage Arugal's worgen hold Shadowfang Keep. The Forsaken at the Sepulcher seek to break his siege on their southern borders. High Executor Hadrec sent Deathstalkers Adamant and Vincent into the fortress to chart its defenses. Days pass without word, and Hadrec grows desperate for their reports. He sends Horde champions into the stronghold to recover the agents and salvage the operation.

quest:1100.text: Lonebrow's Journal. Lonebrow's Journal is an Alliance quest initiated by finding a weathered book held in the hand of a dead dwarf at the base of the Great Lift in Thousand Needles. The notes detail his final journey and prompt the finder to deliver the volume west to a night elf druid stationed on the Feralas border. Near the base of the Great Lift, the massive mechanical elevator connecting the Barrens to the canyon floor of Thousand Needles, lies the body of Henrig Lonebrow. Clutched in his hand is a personal journal detailing his travels through this rugged territory. Left behind in a hostile desert dominated by centaur and tauren, his corpse serves as a grim warning of how unforgiving the canyon can be to isolated travelers. Reading through Henrig's journal reveals his intended path and final wish. Rather than leaving his findings to decay in the canyon, the explorer hoped his records would reach friendly hands. Following the road straight west across Thousand Needles leads out of the dry gullies and toward Thalanaar, the night elf outpost guarding the border to Feralas, where the druid Falfindel Waywarder awaits news of the traveler.

quest:1101.text: The Crone of the Kraul. At Thalanaar, on the border of Feralas and the Thousand Needles, Falfindel Waywarder sends adventurers after Charlga Razorflank. Henrig Lonebrow's recovered journal reveals the growing danger inside Razorfen Kraul. At secluded Thalanaar, the night elf outpost, Falfindel Waywarder grieves for the druid Heralath and the dwarf Henrig Lonebrow. Lonebrow traveled with the Explorers' League before the quilboar captured him. He escaped Razorfen Kraul, but died on the road, leaving a tattered journal that describes the growing menace inside. There is no time to send a runner to Darnassus for military reinforcements. Falfindel sends passing adventurers into the thorned dens to face the danger at its heart. Charlga Razorflank is an ancient geomancer and ruthless matriarch who has united the fractious Razorfen quilboar under her iron rule. From deep within the Kraul, she marshals a bristling army that threatens neighboring lands. Thick thorn mazes, battlement walls, and swarms of fanatical quilboar warriors guard the way to Charlga. Her medallion, taken from her lifeless body, will prove her downfall.

quest:1103.text: Call of Water. Along Silverpine Forest's coast, shamans can renew their communion with water through Call of Water. Tiev Mordune offers another Water Sapta to those whose spirit-sight fades before they speak with the purified water spirit. Shamans drink a Water Sapta to see spirits near the elemental shrines. If its magic fades before they speak with the Minor Manifestation of Water, they can no longer enter the spirit realm to finish the trial. On Silverpine Forest's fog-shrouded shore, fellow shaman Tiev Mordune helps those whose visions end too soon. Tiev Mordune has already defeated the corrupt water spirit off the coast and waits with the ritual remnants he gathered. To show you are ready, bring a fresh Water Sapta from Islen Waterseer in the Barrens. Tiev casts his gathered bracers and droplets into the shrine's brazier, summoning the pure manifestation again so you can speak with it and seal your bond with the element.

quest:1104.text: Salt Flat Venom. Out on the blinding salt expanse of the Shimmering Flats, gnome engineer Fizzle Brassbolts searches for unusual ingredients to supercharge his rocket car. Convinced that the intensely saline venom of local scorpids will produce an ultra-hot burning propellant, he tasks passing adventurers with braving the stinging beasts. The Mirage Raceway is an endless battle of high-speed technical supremacy between gnomish precision and goblin audacity. For Fizzle Brassbolts, standard hydrocarbons and clockwork parts simply are not enough to outpace the competition. He envisions a custom fuel mixture tailored to burn far hotter than conventional propellants, driving their rocket cars across the dried salt lake at blistering speeds. Fizzle's breakthrough relies on the dangerous native fauna of the Shimmering Flats. The local scorpids have evolved to survive in an arid, salt-encrusted wasteland, resulting in an exceptionally saline venom. Rather than fearing its deadly toxicity, Fizzle sees it as a raw chemical payload. Once boiled, refined, and treated with exotic catalytic agents, he believes the salty venom will deliver the explosive combustion required to leave the goblin pit crews in the dust.

quest:1105.text: Hardened Shells. At the Mirage Raceway in the Shimmering Flats, the gnome tinkerer Wizzle Brassbolts worries his brother's potent new rocket fuel will dissolve their racer from the inside out. To prevent a catastrophe on the salt flats, Wizzle enlists passersby to harvest hardened shells from the local tortoises to craft an impervious fuel tank. Out in the blinding heat of the Shimmering Flats, the rivalry between gnome and goblin engineers pushes mechanical ambition to reckless extremes. Wizzle Brassbolts and his brother are determined to dominate the Mirage Raceway with their custom rocket car. However, his brother's experimental fuel mixture is showing signs of being far too potent. Fearing that the corrosive concoction will melt straight through the vehicle's standard chassis and tanks, Wizzle scrambles to find a container tough enough to survive the run. Rather than relying on refined metals that might dissolve under chemical strain, Wizzle turns to the natural adaptations of the salt flats. The native tortoises roaming Thousand Needles possess shells remarkably resistant to harsh elements and mechanical wear. By gathering these hardened carapaces, Wizzle hopes to fashion custom fuel tanks resilient enough to hold the volatile mixture without blowing the rocket car to pieces.

quest:1106.text: Martek the Exiled. Fizzle Brassbolts is building a new engine for his car, but he cannot make pistons hard enough to take the strain. He sends you with a letter to a great smith named Martek the Exiled, far off in a camp in the Badlands. After Salt Flat Venom, Fizzle at the Mirage Raceway explains that his new engine should make the car so fast it could fly. All his trials have failed because he cannot make pistons hard enough for the heavy stress. He knows one person who might know how: Martek the Exiled, a great smith who knows more about metal than anyone. Martek is a long way off in the Badlands, camped there with a goblin, and you carry Fizzle's letter to him.

quest:1107.text: Encrusted Tail Fins. Wizzle Brassbolts at the Mirage Raceway fears the rocket car is so fast that friction will tear it apart. To protect it, he needs tail fins from the Saltscale murlocs at the Vile Reef, off the coast of Stranglethorn Vale. Wizzle calls the rocket car the fastest thing on the Shimmering Flats, and worries that friction will tear it apart. The moving parts need a coat of composite that is hard but not brittle, and able to resist salt corrosion, or the flats will eat the car away. Its key ingredient is the tail fins of the Saltscale murlocs, who live at the Vile Reef, off the coast of Stranglethorn Vale. You are asked to bring Wizzle ten of them.

quest:1108.text: Indurium. Martek the Exiled says the Badlands hold a wealth of metal for anyone with the nerve to get it. Indurium is said to stand up to heat and stress, and Martek wants samples to test whether it could serve Fizzle's racecar. Stonevault troggs out in the Badlands are the ones carrying flakes of it. Martek the Exiled tells you he is not out in the Badlands just to avoid company. The region holds indurium, a metal said to stand up to heat and stress, and it might do for Fizzle's car. Martek wants samples to test, and has the forge hot and waiting. The true ore is deep in Uldaman, but Stonevault troggs in the Badlands carry flakes of it now and then. Martek asks for ten. The troggs that have them roam the south-east slope of a rocky clump at Agmond's End, just south of the Valley of Fangs.

quest:1110.text: Rocket Car Parts. Rocket Car Parts is an errand undertaken for the opportunistic dwarf merchant Kravel Koalbeard on the blinding salt pans of the Shimmering Flats. Rather than letting the violently scattered debris of high-speed racer crashes go to waste, Koalbeard pays wanderers to comb the desert floor and recover wrecked mechanisms to resell directly to the rival gnome and goblin pit crews. The Shimmering Flats serve as the proving ground for the fierce technological rivalry between goblin and gnomish engineers. High-velocity experimental rocket cars routinely suffer catastrophic malfunctions, leaving twisted gears, cylinders, and jagged sheets of metal scattered wide across the vast white desert. While the pit crews focus solely on building and tuning the next machine, the desert floor has quietly become a scrap yard of experimental engineering. Rather than competing directly on the track, the dwarf entrepreneur Kravel Koalbeard recognized a lucrative middleman opportunity at the Mirage Raceway. Gnome and goblin mechanics burn through parts at a furious pace and are constantly desperate for spare mechanisms to slap onto their vehicles. Koalbeard hires travelers to gather thirty bundles of shattered debris, turning devastating crashes into fresh inventory and neatly profiting off the drivers' misfortunes.

quest:1111.text: Wharfmaster Dizzywig. Kravel Koalbeard, a dwarf at the Mirage Raceway, makes it his business to get people what they need. The gnomes there are waiting on parts that reached Ratchet a week ago, and Kravel cannot go himself. He sends you to Ratchet with his parts order for Wharfmaster Dizzywig. Kravel Koalbeard sees to it that people get the things they need. The gnomes of the Mirage Raceway are waiting on a batch of parts that reached Ratchet a week ago, and Kravel cannot make the journey himself. He asks you to do the legwork, and promises more jobs with serious profit potential if you do. Ratchet lies in the Barrens. Wharfmaster Dizzywig, a goblin, is the one to see, and Kravel says Dizzywig will probably be at the docks. You carry Kravel's Parts Order there.

quest:1112.text: Parts for Kravel. Having brought Kravel Koalbeard's parts order to Wharfmaster Dizzywig, you now carry Kravel's package back to him at the Mirage Raceway on the Shimmering Flats. Dizzywig sends a message along with it: if Kravel wants more special orders, he will have to pay his tab. Wharfmaster Dizzywig gives you a package meant for Kravel Koalbeard, who waits at the Mirage Raceway in the Shimmering Flats of Thousand Needles. Dizzywig asks you to pass on a warning with it: if Kravel hopes for more special orders, he must first pay what he owes.

quest:1114.text: Delivery to the Gnomes. Kravel Koalbeard now has what he needs, and wants the Delicate Car Parts carried to Fizzle Brassbolts in the Shimmering Flats, who has waited a long time for them. Kravel admits he removed a little piece from Fizzle's order, and suggests you leave it unmentioned. Kravel Koalbeard tells you the parts are for Fizzle Brassbolts, who has been waiting a long time. Kravel confesses he took one little piece out of Fizzle's order, but feels sure it will not be missed. He calls the piece small and worthless, advises you not to bring it up, and asks you to trust him.

quest:1115.text: The Rumormonger. Having done a service for the gnomes, Kravel Koalbeard now wants to do the goblins a favor. He has heard that Nazz Steamboil, the goblin racer pilot, once went by another name, and wonders whether it is a secret worth money. He sends you to Krazek of Booty Bay, who would know. Kravel Koalbeard says the goblins are next in line for a favor. Nazz Steamboil, the goblin racer pilot, once went by another name, he hears, and Kravel wonders why it changed, whether it hides a secret, and whether Nazz cares to keep it hidden. The one who would know the truth, Kravel says, is Krazek, down at the southern tip of Stranglethorn in Booty Bay. Useful information might turn a profit. Look for Krazek at the Salty Sailor Tavern.

quest:1116.text: Dream Dust in the Swamp. Krazek of Booty Bay says that learning about Nazz is quite a favor. While Krazek contacts sources, you are asked to bring 10 specks of dream dust, taken from dragon whelps in the Swamp of Sorrows, for Krazek's snuff pouch. Bring it back and Krazek will give you the information you seek. Krazek tells you that learning about Nazz is a considerable favor, and that you have already come a long way from the Shimmering Flats for it. While Krazek contacts sources, you are asked to gather something.
